state:
**Goal `ext-intl`: Stage 8, the feature proofs, is in progress.** Stages 1 to 7 are on disk: every export of `nvs:intl/icu` works, both components are embedded, and the growth test and the bundle test pass.

`Novis\Intl\Collator` owes nothing. `sort` and `sortKeys` each have an about page, 3 examples, an attack, a bench with a recorded figure, and a Rust `covers:` marker. `sortKeys` also has its second `.nvst` case. `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Novis\Intl\Collator'` passes.

Still red: the seven other job classes and `Novis\Intl\Icu`, the manifest class. None of them has an about page, examples, an attack or a bench yet. Most have 1 of 2 cases. The gate output names each owed path. `bun nv proofs --id` does not find a `Novis\` feature in any quoting, so use the group gate.

next.title: the feature proofs, one class at a time
next.note: . Each class is its own file set: `docs/examples/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, `tests/hostile/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, `benches/members/novis/Intl-<Class>/`, a new `tests/conformance/novis/intl-*.nvst`, and a `// covers:` line in `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs`. Copy the shape of `Intl-Collator`. After the benches, run `bun nv proofs --record-perf --group '<Class>'`. Then run `bun nv proofs --comments` over the new trees.

items.text: **`Novis\Intl\NumberFormat` owes nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `percent`, `currency` and `compact`, the same set each. Check whether `decimal` is on the roster too. Source half `extensions/intl/nvs/NumberFormat.nvs:1`, Rust test `crates/nvs-ext/tests/intl.rs:288`.

**`Novis\Intl\PluralRules` and `Novis\Intl\RelativeTime` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `cardinal`, `ordinal` and `format`. Source halves `extensions/intl/nvs/PluralRules.nvs:1` and `extensions/intl/nvs/RelativeTime.nvs:1`.

**`Novis\Intl\ListFormat` and `Novis\Intl\Segmenter` owe nothing** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`): `join`, `words` and `sentences`. Source halves `extensions/intl/nvs/ListFormat.nvs:1` and `extensions/intl/nvs/Segmenter.nvs:1`.

backlog: `Novis\Intl\Icu` owes the set for `sentenceSegments`, `resolveLocales`, `negotiate` and the others. Each export may need a skip entry in `data/proofs/` that says the job classes call it (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). See how `Novis\Image\Codec` closed its own.

The Collator benches record about 0.54 ms for a sort of 5 strings and 0.38 ms for 5 sort keys, both flat. That is far above the cost of one crossing (`rule:packaging/the-boundary-is-the-cost`). Find out whether the cost is the per-request instance or the guest's collator construction (`docs/perf/members.ndjson`).
Last: `bun nv proofs --gate` for the whole roster, and `bun nv proofs --comments` over all three `novis` trees.
